detection_focus: High memory or CPU usage indicating crypto-mining or abuse
Processes running under suspicious user contexts
forensic_artifacts: tasklist CSV or LIST output for evidence
Process username and window title context
PID correlation with netstat and event logs

flags.purpose: Filters processes based on criteria like status, imagename, PID, username, services, windowtitle.
flags.security_use_case: Identify suspicious processes using targeted filters such as memory, name, or user.
flags.threat_detected: Suspicious names, high memory usage, unexpected user contexts.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Requires correct filter syntax.
flags.safe_followup: Correlate PID with netstat; capture memory dump before termination.

flags.purpose: Lists DLL modules loaded into processes to detect injection or unusual libraries.
flags.security_use_case: Detect suspicious DLLs injected into legitimate processes.
flags.threat_detected: DLL injection, trojanized binaries, abnormal module loads.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Large output if module not specified.
flags.safe_followup: Investigate suspicious DLL paths; verify file signatures.

flags.purpose: Maps Windows services to their hosting processes.
flags.security_use_case: Understand what services svchost.exe or other processes are running.
flags.threat_detected: Malware masquerading as a service or hiding within service hosts.
flags.safe_followup: Check service config with sc.exe query; review service paths.

flags.purpose: Shows verbose process details including username and window title.
flags.security_use_case: Identify processes running under abnormal user privileges.
flags.threat_detected: Privilege escalation, hidden background malware processes.
flags.safe_followup: Cross-check username against expected sessions; inspect process path.

flags.purpose: Formats output for automation or PowerShell parsing.
flags.security_use_case: Export process list to SIEM or automated scripts for analysis.
flags.threat_detected: Enables pattern detection across process data.
flags.safe_followup: Parse CSV with PowerShell; correlate with other logs.

flags.purpose: Displays Windows Store apps and their processes.
flags.security_use_case: Monitor AppContainer processes for abnormal behavior.
flags.threat_detected: Compromised Store apps or misuse of sandboxed permissions.
flags.safe_followup: Review app permissions and network activity.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Provides full context including username and window title for triage.
detection_queries.security_context: Baseline process inventory for incident response.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Shows DLL injection and module loading patterns.
detection_queries.security_context: Detect code injection or suspicious libraries.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Maps services to processes for service abuse detection.
detection_queries.security_context: Identify malware hiding as Windows service.

tool_relationship.paired_with: taskkill, netstat, procdump, schtasks, reg query
tool_relationship.attacker_usage: Attackers enumerate processes to identify security tools to kill.
tool_relationship.defender_usage: Enumerate, analyze, and triage processes before containment.
